subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should existing bundled skill descriptions get concise WHEN/trigger wording now, or should trigger-like routing move to a structured skill metadata contract instead?
rationale: Current source still uses descriptions as a selection signal, but OpenClaw docs and compact prompt behavior push toward short descriptions, so automation should not choose the public skill-authoring policy.

options.title: Approve concise description cleanup
options.body: Land one focused metadata-only pass that adds short WHEN wording only where it improves existing bundled skill routing without bloating descriptions.

options.title: Defer to structured triggers
options.body: Keep descriptions compact and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782 the canonical owner for explicit trigger semantics.

options.title: Decline trigger expansion
options.body: Document that concise WHAT-only descriptions are intentional and close or supersede wording-only cleanup attempts.

recommendation.title: Approve concise description cleanup
recommendation.body: Land one focused metadata-only pass that adds short WHEN wording only where it improves existing bundled skill routing without bloating descriptions.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest current source-history signal for the prompt formatter and related maintainer guidance on broad skill-description churn.
